description: This Java source file defines the 'InterestRateChartSlab' class, which models a slab (or segment) within an interest rate chart used in interest rate management. It includes entity relationships, creation, update, and incentive management functionalities, and is part of the domain model in an interest rate charting system.

classes.name: InterestRateChartSlab
classes.description: Entity class representing a slab within an interest rate chart, including methods for creating, updating, and managing its incentives.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new InterestRateChartSlab instance with specified fields and parent chart.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the slab based on a JSON command, validating data and updating incentives.

methods.name: updateIncentives
methods.description: Manages adding, updating, or removing incentives associated with the interest rate slab based on JSON input.
